data.rationale: The proposal follows the same steps in the same order as the true workflow (search, open restaurant, set date and guests, click Notify, set preferred times, confirm) and covers every true parameter, with time split into start/end and an extra meal_period parameter, but the Notify step ("for the meal period or after the time slots") is a little vague about which button to click.
